decisions.decision: Build it. Keep 'Cold WhatsApp (through Tantra)' on Pick your channels and make it real. (1) Add a copy card, d2-whatsapp-copy, that writes a short opener plus 2 follow-ups. Write it in the Backlinko voice, keep it under WhatsApp's length limits, and make every message carry an opt-out line. (2) Add a Tantra job, tantra-whatsapp, that adds a WhatsApp step to the attendee's Tantra omni-channel campaign. It runs only on rows with a phone number AND a recorded consent flag, skips and counts every other row, and shows the count on the card. Never use Twilio. (3) Change the option's teaching to say this: a bought cold list rarely has phone numbers, so this only reaches rows with a consented number. If none have one, the card says so and skips cleanly. (4) Test against our simulator and test attendees only, then run probe-day-model and check-coverage, deploy, and move the task to review with ?v= links.
decisions.why: Adi's own vision (centre-vision-2026-10-14) lists cold WhatsApp (through Tantra) as a channel option, and on 2026-10-03 he said WhatsApp runs on Tantra alone. Building it keeps his design, and T-489 doesn't have to block. The consent-only filter fixes the missing-numbers gap.
